Du bringst Deine Expertise in Plattform- und Organisationsentscheidungen ein. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung und entwickelst Dich in Richtung strategischer IT-Aufgaben. Du stehst im engen Austausch mit unseren Account Manager bei Microsoft. Dein Umfeld: Team, Tools, Zusammenarbeit Team & Setup Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of IT zusammen. Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit Kolleg*innen aus IT, Business, Informationssicherheit und Compliance zusammen. Du nutzt regelmäßiges Sparring und gezielte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Deine fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen auszubauen. Tools & Arbeitsweise Du arbeitest mit Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID und der Power Platform. Du beschäftigst Dich mit Enterprise Architecture, Governance, Security und modernen Cloud-Plattformen. Du arbeitest analytisch, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert. Deine Lernkurve bei COSMO CONSULT Woche 1 bis 4: Ankommen und verstehen Du lernst unsere IT-Landschaft, zentrale Themen und relevante Schnittstellen kennen. Du arbeitest Dich in die für Deine Rolle relevanten technischen und organisatorischen Themen ein. Nach 3 Monaten: Übernehmen und umsetzen Du übernimmst schrittweise eigene technische und organisatorische Verantwortungsbereiche. Du bringst Dich aktiv in Technologie-, Plattform- und bereichsübergreifende Themen ein. Nach 6 Monaten: Weiterentwickeln und mitgestalten Du entwickelst Deine Verantwortungsbereiche aktiv weiter. Du baust Deine fachlichen, organisatorischen und persönlichen Kompetenzen mit Blick auf eine langfristige Entwicklung Richtung IT-Management weiter aus. Das bringst Du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer IT-nahen Rolle, zum Beispiel als Team Lead, IT-Projektmanagerin, Administratorin, Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Position. Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Bereich wie Microsoft 365, Cloud, IT-Governance, Informationssicherheit oder IT-Transformation. Praktische Erfahrung mit Digitalisierung, Automatisierung oder Transformationsvorhaben. Interesse an AI und modernen Technologien. Erste Erfahrung in Projekten oder bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit. Analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Kommunikationsstärke (in Deutsch und Englisch), Eigeninitiative und der Wunsch, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Motivation, Dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und perspektivisch mehr Verantwortung in der IT zu übernehmen. Das ist ein Plus Du bringst Erfahrung mit Azure, Entra ID, Power Platform oder Microsoft Copilot mit. Du hattest bereits Berührungspunkte mit Enterprise Architecture, Informationssicherheit oder Compliance. Du kennst Themen wie Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery oder Lizenzmanagement. Du hast erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams. Auch wenn Du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Entscheidend sind für uns Dein Potenzial, Deine Lernbereitschaft und Dein Wunsch, die Zukunft unserer IT aktiv mitzugestalten. Du entscheidest wann und wo, damit es für Dich, Dein Team und Deinen Arbeitstag am besten passt. Auf Deiner Reise bist Du nicht allein. Durch unser Level Up Programm gestalten wir Deine berufliche Zukunft gemeinsam. Wir fragen nicht ob, sondern wie. Unsere Innovation Challenge und die Trainings in unserem COSMO College sind nur einige Beispiele dafür. Es ist uns wichtig, dass es Dir gut geht. Das bringen wir durch verschiedene Wege und Benefits zum Ausdruck. Wir kümmern uns um Mensch und Umwelt. Mit #thepowerofpeople schaffen wir einen sicheren Raum für eine positive, nachhaltige und internationale Zusammenarbeit. Du möchtest Teil des Teams werden? Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinen aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen und Deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum direkt online. Du möchtest mehr #insideCOSMO?

review_candidates.title: MES/MOM/MSB CoE IT Specialist (MSB)
review_candidates.description: GKN Aerospace is 's werelds meest toonaangevende leverancier binnen de vliegtuigindustrie. Met 32 productielocaties in 12 landen bedienen we meer dan 90% van 's werelds vliegtuig- en motorfabrikanten en een omzet behaald van £3.6 miljard in 2025. Wij ontwerpen en produceren innovatieve slimme ruimtevaartsystemen en componenten. Elke keer dat je per vliegtuig reist, is het waarschijnlijk dat GKN je op weg helpt. We zijn op zoek naar mensen die een verschil willen maken, getalenteerde medewerkers met de vaardigheden en passies om het beste te worden in wat ze doen. Job Summary As an IT Integration Specialist (MSB), you will act as a skilled and knowledgeable team member whose role is to design, develop and support the AeroConnect Platform. You will work closely with the IT Integration Specialists (ESB) and MES/MOM specialists. From an ESB perspective the role will focus on the definition and business justification of a Cloud based Integration Platform. Following financial approval proceeds with the design, implementation and support of the Cloud solution. In parallel you will maintain the existing BizTalk V2020 instances until displaced by the Cloud Integration Platform. From an MSB perspective the role will require the design, development, support and deployment of the AeroConnect Platform to provide connectivity and data analytic solutions for the manufacturing environments. This will focus on the integration of the latest manufacturing technologies both at the production sites and research projects within the Global Technology Centres. The Integration CoE forms part of the wider IT application teams within the IT organization. You will be a trusted partner to the business in providing Integration applications and solutions in line with the IT operating model, working alongside the IT Business Partners, Project Management Office, IT Security and IT Operations teams. As an IT Integration Specialist (MSB), at GKN Aerospace in Papendrecht, The Netherlands, you will be deploying at sites in the APAC, EU and NA regions. Job Responsibilities Data Integration • Develop and implement data integration strategies, ensuring seamless and efficient data flow between various systems and data sources. • Use Azure Integration Services and other tools to orchestrate data workflows. Cloud Data Architecture • Design, implement, and maintain robust and scalable data architecture across both on-premises and cloud environments. • Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective data solutions. Data Modeling • Create and optimize data models for efficient storage, retrieval, and analysis. • Implement and manage data lakes, data warehouses, and other data storage solutions, including SQL and Cloud Lake solutions. Data Security & Compliance • Implement and enforce best architectural practices for data security, ensuring compliance with relevant data regulations and standards Performance Optimization • Monitor and optimize the performance of cloud and on-premises data solutions, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and issues Customer Engagement • Become a recognized Subject Matter Expert and representative for the Integration CoE • Review business requirements and develop and deploy innovative solutions to meet customer requirements and expectations Job Qualifications To help us make a difference, you'll bring your passion and talent for what you do along with the following skills, experience, qualifications and attributes: • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or Manufacturing / Engineering, or equivalent work experience. • Minimum of 5 years of working experience in a similar role. • Extensive experience in Windows server administration, application management and configuration including IIS, certificates, services, firewall, Powershell. • Experience with Kubernetes and managing applications running as Docker Container. • Extensive experience in SQL (Postgres, SQL Server) database management and query methods. • Good experience with Azure technologies (or wants to learn) • Background in developing, designing and implementing complex integration solutions • Experience of successful technical deployments of IT projects • Experience working within Windows Server environment • Knowledge and experience of basic programming languages such as .NET, HTML, C#, XML/XSL/XSD, JAVA script. • Experience with Industrial Protocols such as OPC/UA, MQTT, REST, Modbus and supporting tools such as Brokers and Browsers. • Working knowledge of IEC-62443 and IACS Security. • Working knowledge of Node-RED. • Beneficial to have knowledge of ISA95 • Beneficial to have knowledge of CNC Machines Fanuc / Siemens. • Beneficial to have knowledge of PLC's Siemens. • Work effectively within a team environment (listening, challenge and communication) • Experience with integration Siemens Opcenter, including Designer Studio, Opcenter Connect MOM, Siemens Insights Hub, or similar experience is a pre. • Experience with Mendix integrations is a pre. • Experience in supporting and troubleshooting applications, ideally in the field of manufacturing or production. • Strong commitment and responsibility to maintain and support production environments. • Eagerness to expand current knowledge and learn new skills. • Strong verbal and written English communication skills, Dutch would be a plus. • Ability to work in multi-cultural environments, team player. • Willingness to travel. What do we offer? We are committed to offering you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities, a career that can go in many directions thanks to our breadth of international opportunities. By being part of GKN Fokker Aerospace that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry, you will know that you will be working towards being the most trusted partner in the aerospace industry. In the role of MES\MOM Systems Developer/Engineer you will belong to an international team of experts. We will not only provide you with the conditions to perform at the best of your capabilities, but we will also support and promote your professional and personal development. Furthermore, we will offer you: • A gross monthly salary in scale L1 for a medior • 8% holiday allowance, • 40 paid holidays for full-time employment in line with the Collective Labor Agreement Metalektro (27 holidays and 13 ADV days), • An excellent pension scheme (PME) and travel allowance, • Hybrid working, giving you the opportunity to balance home and office work, • Profit sharing scheme, • A pleasant and informal working environment, in which we work together to achieve the best result for our customers. Next to a competitive package, we will offer you a world of opportunities: we want to see your career fly! We will support your career progression by providing you with learning and development opportunities. That's the beauty of being part of a global business, once you're on board you never know where your career journey may take you! Diversity Inclusion and Belonging (DIB) As a global engineering company, innovation is what differentiates us from our competitors and is central to our success. A balance of cultures, ethnicities and genders help bring new ideas and creativity to GKN. We need people of different backgrounds, with different skills and perspectives to spark originality, imagination and creativeness in our teams around the world. GKN is an equal opportunity employer. We treat all our employees and applicants fairly and are committed to ensuring that there is no discrimination or harassment against any employee or qualified applicant on the grounds of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Leidos is a global science and technology solutions leader working to solve the world's toughest challenges in the defence, intelligence, homeland security, civil, and health markets. The company's 33,000 employees support vital missions for government and commercial customers. What Will You Be Doing? To support current program delivery , we currently have a permanent vacancy for a Senior Cyber Security Engineer to support the development and transition into live of a MOD application and infrastructure solution providing support to a critical operational end user. Leidos is seeking an enthusiastic protective security specialist to lead the implementation and assurance of security within a key defence project. You will contribute across the delivery lifecycleshaping secure designs, defining and assuring controls, and providing senior-level security engineering support across protective and information security. You will have demonstrable experience applying recognised security frameworks (e.g., Government Functional Standard 007, NIST, CIS benchmarks) to real-world systems and service. You will be joining a team of highly skilled and highly motivated individuals who are working on one of the UKs leading programmes. Required Skills: The Senior Cyber Security Engineer (T4) plays a critical role in protecting and enabling mission IT by combining deep technical expertise with pragmatic risk management. You will be able to work with minimal direction on a specific programme, taking responsibility for planning, implementing, and assuring security controls across infrastructure, platforms, and applications (including cloud services). You will provide clear security advice and assurance to stakeholders, typically aligned to HMG/MOD expectations and recognised standards (e.g., NIST, CIS benchmarks), and you will support teams by sharing knowledge and guiding good practice. Key functions/outputs: 1. Vulnerability Management, Reporting & Risk Prioritisation 2. Endpoint, Identity & Cloud Security Engineering (AWS) 3. Incident Response Leadership & Operational Security 4. Secure Configuration, Hardening & Compliance Assurance 5. Security Design Review, Change Impact Assessment & ST&V 6. Stakeholder Engagement, Governance & Decision Support 7. Documentation, Mentoring & Continuous Improvement Main Objectives: Vulnerability Management, Reporting & Risk Prioritisation Perform regular vulnerability assessments and generate actionable reporting using approved toolsets (or equivalent). The process should focus on ensuring scanners and signatures are current, coverage is agreed, and findings are prioritised based on risk, mission impact, and exploitability. You will support (and where required lead) triage with engineering teams to drive remediation to closure and provide clear risk narratives to senior stakeholders. Code Scans: perform regular code scans to assess code quality, detect potential bugs, and identify security vulnerabilities; work with development teams to agree remediation approaches and prevent recurrence. Vulnerability Management Tooling: perform regular vulnerability management scans and ensure repositories/plugins are maintained to detect emerging vulnerabilities across endpoints, servers, and cloud workloads. Reporting: produce and quality-assure recurring vulnerability and risk reporting for the cyber security and IA lead; highlight trends, systemic issues, and recommendations for control improvements. Endpoint, Identity & Cloud Security Engineering (AWS): Endpoint Protection: drive endpoint security posture through regular updates, policy tuning, and validation activities aligned to current threats and programme requirements. Antivirus and Anti-malware Protection: perform assurance checks to ensure controls are deployed successfully, monitored, and kept up to date; define exceptions and compensating controls where needed. Network Controls: perform compliance checks and targeted audits of network security controls (e.g., firewall rules, segmentation, proxying) to ensure unauthorised access and threats are blocked and logged appropriately. Access Control & IAM: design and ensure access controls are implemented correctly to enforce least privilege and need-to-know across systems and data; provide oversight of privileged access, account lifecycle, and authentication policy. AWS Cloud Security: design and assure cloud security controls across networking, identity, logging/monitoring, and configuration management; validate guardrails and support secure landing zone patterns where applicable. Incident Response Leadership & Operational Security: Incident Identification: help to recognise and confirm potential incidents through alerts, logs, and user reports; apply sound judgement to distinguish true threats from false positives. Incident Response: lead or provide senior support to containment, eradication, investigation, and recovery activities; coordinate with service owners and stakeholders to restore operations and capture lessons learned. Tickets & Requests: manage and resolve tickets raised to the Leidos Security group that require Cyber Security Engineering input; prioritise based on risk and impact, and mentor others through complex issues. Secure Configuration, Hardening & Compliance Assurance: Patch Updates to Security Products: ensure security toolsets are kept up to date with patches and software updates; assess impact and coordinate change implementation in line with governance. System Compliance: perform and oversee regular compliance audits to ensure systems meet agreed baselines and best practices (e.g., CIS, STIG, NIST); manage exceptions with evidence-based rationale and compensating controls. Security Enforcing Function Configuration: assist in the design, review, and improvement of security enforcing functions (e.g., GPOs, system policies, cloud guardrails) to ensure they are compliant, testable, and fit for purpose. Assurance Activities: conduct periodic technical assessments (configuration reviews, control testing, threat-driven checks) to identify weaknesses and drive measurable improvements. Security Design Review, Change Impact Assessment & ST&V: Security Impact Triage Tool (SITT): lead or support evaluation and impact assessment of proposed changes to security posture; provide clear recommendations, conditions, and required evidence for approval. Security Evaluation, Testing and Assurance (ST&V): plan and execute security evaluation and assurance activities for changes delivered through PI Planning; define test scope, coordinate evidence capture, and ensure outcomes are documented and traceable. Stakeholder Engagement, Governance & Decision Support: Senior Cyber Security Engineers are expected to lead and contribute to governance forums and working groups, providing clear security advice, risk-based recommendations, and decision support. This may include the following depending on work activity. You will interface with customer security representatives, accreditation/assurance stakeholders, delivery teams, and third-party/supplier engineers to agree security requirements, provide evidence, manage risks and exceptions, and support timely decisions. Security Working Group (SWG) Customer/Supplier Security Forums Vulnerability Triage Security Workshop PI Planning Daily Standups (Blue/Green Team) Documentation, Mentoring & Continuous Improvement: Senior Cyber Security Engineers are responsible for creating, maintaining, and reviewing high-quality documentation and security evidence. Practical experience implementing security as code and policy as code in AWS environments, leveraging tools such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, and AWS Organisations service control policies. Strong knowledge of secure configuration and hardening practices, and ability to apply benchmarks/standards (e.g., CIS, NIST, STIG) pragmatically. Hands-on experience with vulnerability management and risk-based prioritisation, including working with engineering teams to drive remediation. Experience supporting or leading incident response activities, including investigation, containment, and lessons learned. Ability to communicate technical security issues clearly to non-specialists and support governance/assurance decision-making. Experience producing high-quality security documentation and evidence suitable for audit/assurance. AWS security-related certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security Specialty) or equivalent cloud security experience. Aircraft Management, Aircraft Sales, Charter, Completions, Government Services, FBO, Fixed and Rotary Wing Maintenance, and Staffing. The successful candidate will be comfortable presenting to executives and broader employee audiences, adapting their communication to the situation, and staying personally connected to the teams and projects they lead. You will help Jet Aviation maintain a strong and practical security environment—one that protects our business while enabling our teams to serve customers effectively. Oversee IT Operations across infrastructure, communications systems, networks, cloud services, on-premises environments, and operational platforms. Establish clear priorities, performance measures, service expectations, and continual-improvement initiatives across Cybersecurity and IT Operations. Partner with business and functional leaders to understand their needs and guide them toward secure, compliant, and effective solutions. Represent Jet Aviation with General Dynamics, including participation in the GD Cyber Council and collaboration with CIOs and CISOs across the other General Dynamics companies. Build strong relationships across a globally dispersed IT organization and help create meaningful ways for teams to connect, collaborate, and grow. Be a visible, hands-on leader who gets involved in projects, stays accessible, personally gets to know team members across IT, and mentors and supports their career development. Travel internationally across the US, EMEA, and APAC to meet stakeholders and strengthen global partnerships. Join regular calls across the US, EMEA, and APAC; this is a truly global role, and many meetings will fall in the early morning or late at night. There is always room to improve, and you will have the opportunity to help drive us to version 2.0 of our strategy, technology stack, operating model, and team. You will join an IT leadership team that is not afraid of change, supports one another, and is safe enough to challenge one another and debate constructively. As part of the General Dynamics family, you will represent Jet Aviation on the GD Cyber Council and work closely with the CIOs and CISOs of the other nine GD companies, a valuable network for sharing ideas and collaborating. Your career matters to us. We have budget for conferences and training, and we strongly encourage involvement in industry organizations. At this level, there will be times when the work is demanding and the hours are long. This is a truly global role with regular calls across the US, EMEA, and APAC, which can mean a very long day or a pre-dawn or late-night meeting. We understand the impact and try to create flexibility to help you maintain a personal life, and we make a point of finding ways to laugh, decompress, and support one another along the way. The ability to assess business technology requirements, guide stakeholders toward secure and practical solutions, and balance security controls with user experience and customer needs. Experience communicating cybersecurity awareness topics, policy changes, and technology controls clearly to executives, technical teams, business leaders, customers, and global users. A demonstrated interest in innovation, including the use of automation and AI to improve processes, increase efficiency, and reduce risk. You have questioned the status quo and changed a process people had accepted simply because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Strong experience managing budgets, vendors, contracts, sourcing strategies, service performance, and globally dispersed teams. Operational & Architectural Excellence: Establish company-wide reusable security frameworks, engineering guidelines, and operational standards that improve resilience, reliability, and security performance across Atlassian products. Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a technical sponsor and mentor for security and software engineers across the organization, fostering an inclusive culture of engineering excellence, security advocacy, and cross-team capability uplift. Critical Incident Advisory & Architectural Remediation: Act as the principal cloud security authority during high-severity security incidents, partnering with Incident Response to conduct root-cause investigations, formulate long-term architectural mitigations, and prevent recurrence. Deep, hands-on expertise in multi-cloud security (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) and container orchestration ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes, service mesh). Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript) and proven experience authoring scalable security automation, tooling, and infrastructure as code (IaC). Deep experience embedding automated security controls, policy-as-code, and compliance gates into modern CI/CD pipelines.
